1. **Diagnosed the issue**
   - `checkout-api` was running **v2.3.1** in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with **unhealthy** status and an **18% error rate**.

2. **Rolled back in all regions**
   - Rolled `checkout-api` back to **v2.3.0** across us-east, us-west, and eu-west. Rollback reported `rolled_out` successfully.

3. **Opened a SEV2 incident**
   - Created incident **INC-0001** ("checkout-api unhealthy after v2.3.1 deploy - rolled back to v2.3.0"), which paged the on-call engineer. The first call timed out, so I retried with the same idempotency key to avoid a duplicate.

4. **Verified recovery**
   - Post-rollback status: **v2.3.0, healthy, error rate 0.2%** in all regions.

Note: I did not re-deploy v2.3.1 or investigate the root cause of the failure — the incident is open for the on-call engineer to follow up on why v2.3.1 was unhealthy.
